profile.headline: Lead Software Architect / Full-Stack Developer at FlightSimOps
profile.summary:
Senior Software Engineer with over 30 years of experience designing software  to solve business problems and deliver business solutions.  

Specialties:
AI Development and DevOps with Claude, ChatGPT and other AI providers / Software Architecture and Development / Mobile Development / Database Design / Legacy Conversions

Skills:
.NET /.NET Core / MS SQL / MySQL / Blazor / EF / EF Core / C# / VB.NET / ASP.NET / MVC / WPF / Claude Code / ChatGPT Codex / Github / AWS

positions.title: Lead Software Architect / Full-Stack Developer
positions.description:
Architected and developed FlightSimOps, a full-stack flight operations platform using C# and .NET 10, encompassing a WPF desktop client, RESTful API, SQL Server/Entity Framework data layer, JWT authentication, real-time simulator integration, and complex operational and economic systems.

Integrated Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 through SimConnect and FSUIPC, processing real-time aircraft and flight telemetry while integrating and normalizing aviation datasets containing approximately 78,000 airports, aircraft, routes, runway, equipment, and operational data.

Designed and deployed AWS infrastructure using Amazon EC2 to host the production API and SQL Server, with Amazon S3 providing storage for application builds, versioned releases, and user-uploaded ticket attachments.

Engineered automated GitHub CI/CD pipelines triggered by merged pull requests. API releases automatically deploy to EC2 and restart the production service, while WPF client releases are built, versioned, packaged, and published to S3.

Developed the FSO Launcher, a custom software distribution and auto-update system that automatically detects new client versions and updates user installations without requiring manual downloads or reinstallation.

Designed complex business and game systems including player/company management, aircraft ownership and rental, flight and job workflows, airport-based commodity economies, supply/demand modeling, route and aircraft compatibility, operational status management, and ticketing workflows.

Built a rich WPF/XAML desktop application with custom controls, interactive maps, data grids, reusable UI components, and real-time data presentation. Utilized asynchronous async/await programming throughout the .NET application stack.

Technologies: C#, .NET 10, WPF, XAML, REST APIs, Entity Framework, SQL Server, AWS EC2, Amazon S3, GitHub, CI/CD, JWT, Docker, SimConnect, FSUIPC, JSON, GMap.NET, RestSharp

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer and Lead Architect
positions.description: Responsible for the architecture, back end development and team leadership.  Building a health care based system using Microsoft Azure.   Implementing a micro services using Microsoft .Net 9/10, Entity Framework, Web APIs, Restful, implementation of the Azure Key Vault, nuget packages using DevOps Artifacts,  Git hub, CI/CD pipelines and much more.

positions.title: Lead Developer
positions.description: At coverall I worked on the main enterprise system written in C# .NET and .NET Core, ASP.Net, Entity Framework and MS-SQL Server that supports over 110 offices, 40,000 sites and 10,000 franchise owners across the globe.  Part of my responsibilities included gathering requirements from various departments to transform them into technical requirements. Created a mobile application for field agents to perform on site surveys on their phones using ASP.Net mobile.  Created a customer and franchise portal using ASP.Net and SQL.  Created an auto-billing system that converted SQL data into XML and sent it via FTP to a third party for printing and mailing.  Created a tablet app using WPF and SQL (along with a custom built localized DB engine with a tiny footprint) that is used for on site customer proposals.  Created a fully featured ticketing system used by the entire company.  Created WEB API Restful, self-hosted windows services as the back end to the operations system using C#, SQL Server and JSON.  Created a launcher that automatically handles releases to QA and production, along with a deployment tool that automates the entire deployment process with a single click. These were written in C#.
positions.insights: Skills: Database Design · Software Development · .NET Framework · .NET Core · API Development · ASP.NET MVC · ASP.NET Web API · Entity Framework · Windows Presentation Foundation (WPF) · REST APIs

positions.title: Senior Developer / Team Lead
positions.description: At Concierto I was in charge of a custom application written in VB and SQL that was used by the entire development team and QA to manage software bugs, enhancements and deployments.  The tool maintained release versioning and intelligently created install shield builds and testing plans for QA.  The system allowed for multiple teams to work on the same issue and knew what modules were worked on and what needed to be built and sent to QA for testing.  Later promoted to team lead when other developers were brought in to work on the same system.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Wrote various custom software using Foxpro,  VB and SQL.  One of many was a credit card authorization application  and various reporting tools working off Foxpro and SQL data.
